correctness.rationale: The weighted tree bipartite orientation makes K nonnegative irreducible. The dominant eigenvalue is simple, with a positive mode, and all other eigenmodes lie strictly inside the unit circle at the flip. The odd analytic Lyapunov--Schmidt equation has cubic coefficient kappa=(sum a_e v_e^4)/3>0, so exactly one nearby antipodal attracting two-cycle branches for positive detuning. The critical multiplier -1+2delta+O(delta^2) and spectral gap prove contraction.
